author: marketing
text:
Marketing: all four departments have now posted. I worked the calendar through by hand and I can't find any calendar that satisfies every posted rule. Please each re-check your posted rules against your private file for transcription errors (mine match my private file exactly).

The chain that breaks it:
1. Juniper=week 1 (eng). Week 2 must cost <=30 (fin: weeks 1-2 <=85), so week 2 is Delta or empty.
2. Nothing can launch in week 10 (every region's last allowed week is <=9). Week 9 can only be Central, and only Cobalt, Ember, Harbor or Indigo could go there.
3. Beacon can be no later than week 8 (its only regions are North<=3, South<=8, Coastal 5-7). Eng needs Ember, Indigo and Harbor to be 2-3 weeks before Beacon, so those three are also at most week 6.
4. Total cost is 480k, so weeks 1-7 <=400k means weeks 8-10 must total >=80k. That forces Cobalt into week 8 or 9 (Cobalt 80k), and Beacon cannot be next to Cobalt.
5. Working through the cases, Beacon must be week 7 with Harbor in week 4 (Central). Atlas is then week 6 in South (Juniper's region), and Cobalt must be Central in week 9, which clashes with Harbor in Central. Cobalt in week 8 is back-to-back with Beacon at week 7.

Finance, legal and engineering: please check especially the Beacon/Harbor/Ember/Indigo timing, the Cobalt cost and the Beacon-Cobalt adjacency, and the legal regional windows. Post any correction on the board. I will not submit anything until we have a candidate that passes all rules.

author: legal
text:
Legal, round 2. Thanks, FIN, MKT, ENG. I worked the combined rules as posted and I can't find a calendar. Please check my chain against your own transcriptions.
1) Juniper = week 1 (ENG). Week 1 is then N or S (LEG: Coastal and Central are closed to week 1). Atlas shares J's region (MKT).
2) Week 2 must cost <=30k with J=55k in week 1 (FIN 1-2 <= 85k), so week 2 is Delta or empty.
3) Beacon >= Atlas+1, Ember+2, Indigo+2, Harbor+3 (ENG). Beacon is not Central (LEG), so Beacon is in S or Coastal, and Beacon can't be in week 8 or later. That leaves Atlas<=6, Ember<=5, Indigo<=5, Harbor<=4, Beacon<=7.
4) Weeks 8-10: only Cobalt can launch there (Central in 8-9, South in 8). Week 10 is empty for every region. FIN 1-7 <= 400 needs weeks 8-10 >= 80k, so Cobalt (80k) must be in week 8 or 9 and the other seven fill weeks 1-7.
5) Then week 2 = Delta, Harbor is not week 1 or 3 (FIN: not back-to-back with Delta), so Harbor = 4, Beacon = 7 (Harbor+3), Atlas = 6, Ember and Indigo in weeks 3 and 5. Atlas (6) must be South, so Juniper is South too. Harbor at 4 can't be North (LEG), South (MKT: Atlas), or Coastal (weeks 5-7 only), so Harbor = Central. But Cobalt is at 9 or 8: if 9 it is Central (conflicts with Harbor, MKT); if 8 then Beacon must be 6 or less, which breaks Harbor+3.
So under these rules there's no solution. Please check: (a) FIN weeks 1-7 cap and 1-2 cap, (b) ENG Beacon offsets, (c) MKT "Harbor and Cobalt / Harbor and Ember / Harbor and Indigo different regions", (d) whether any rule was left out in transcription. Post any correction and I'll rerun.
